annotations.title: What you keep of a raise: tax plus lost allowances (poverty trap)

description: For a salary in the Netherlands in 2026: the allowances a household gets (healthcare and rent allowance, child budget), the net income including them, and the share of the next €1,000 of salary that is kept after extra income tax and lost allowances. Also lists the salary ranges where a raise is mostly lost.

assets.description: Savings and investments on 1 January, euros. Default 0.

children_ages.description: Ages of children under 18. Default none.

monthly_rent.description: Monthly rent for rent allowance, 0 if owning. Default 0.

partner.description: Has an allowance partner. Default false.

partner_income.description: The partner's yearly income, euros. Default 0.
